summary: Redwood Trust Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose it entered into an underwriting agreement to sell $125 million of 9.75% senior notes due 2031, with an over-allotment option of $18.75 million. The offering is registered under an existing Form S-3 shelf. Morgan Stanley, RBC, UBS, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs, and Piper Sandler are underwriters. Expected close is May 27, 2026. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
